milestones.proof: Independent polynomial/LOESS fixtures; shared facet controls; 10,000 rows across ten groups.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Ordinary scatter plus completed optional native features.

milestones.evidence: Polynomial (degree 2–6, QR on standardized X) and LOESS (tricube, local linear; exact up to 500 rows, 201 interpolated vertices above). Checked against exact rational and brute-force references. 10,000 rows in ten groups plus an overall fit: LOESS ≈14 ms, other methods under 10 ms in Node.
